mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_billing_scans(actor_id, operation_id) VALUES(#{actor}, #{operation}) ON CONFLICT(actor_id, operation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id, scanned, warning, active, completed_at FROM nw_platform_billing_scans WHERE actor_id = #{actor} AND operation_id = #{operation} AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_billing_scans SET scanned=#{scanned}, warning=#{warning}, active=#{active}, completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE actor_id=#{actor} AND operation_id=#{operation} AND completed_at IS NULL
